tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from four different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Meta launches paid models to compete with OpenAI and Anthropic, confirmed by bgnes. The company is expanding its artificial intelligence offerings in the competitive market.
Navitas and NVIDIA launch a 24 kilowatt GaNFast board for artificial intelligence data centers with 97 percent efficiency, reported by Pluang. The power solution targets the growing demands of large-scale computing infrastructure.
Nvidia delays the 24 gigabyte RTX 5080 Super to the first quarter of 2027 due to GDDR7 supply issues, confirmed by Startup Fortune. Graphics memory constraints are affecting the release timeline for high-end hardware.
Anthropic bans persistent harmful behavior toward its Claude models effective November 2026, reported by BornCity. The policy addresses misuse and establishes new community standards for model interaction.
Free every hour.
